name: Curtain-Caller

abilities.name: Faces in the Dark
abilities.description: While the curtain-caller is in dim light or darkness and a creature within 30 feet of it is charmed by it, the charmed creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't willingly move farther from the curtain-caller until the start of the curtain-caller's next turn.

abilities.name: Captain's Charm (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: One creature the curtain-caller can see within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed until the start of the curtain-caller's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The curtain-caller makes three attacks, using Rapier or Hand Crossbow.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the curtain-caller has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

generation.userConcept: a carnival barker who talks you into standing still

other_edition.lore: A failed showman whose last audience never left their seats, it stalks the barker's booths of abandoned fairs, promising a once-in-a-lifetime attraction to anyone who will only stand still and wait for the curtain.
